newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Gunmen kill four political activists in Karachi.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill four political activists in Karachi.

text.p: Motorcycle gunmen shot dead four political activists in Karachi, southern Pakistan, police said on Monday.

The unidentified gunmen sprayed bullets while riding on a motorbike overnight at a Mohajir National Movement (MQM) office at Shara-i-Faysal Colony, killing two MQM activists and wounding three, a police official said.
A political worker was kidnapped at Liaquatabad in Karachi and killed after being shot in the mouth, police said.
The bullet-riddled body of another political worker was found overnight at Quaidabad, also in Karachi, the official said.
The MQM and its splinter Haqiqi group accuse each other of violence but neither has taken responsibility.

Since Pakistan's general elections on February 3, at least 45 people have died in violence in Karachi, where more than 500 people were killed in ethnic and sectarian violence in 1996 and 2,000 in 1995.
The MQM represents Urdu-speaking people who migrated from India in 1947.
